lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: It's not dead. It's barely slowed down.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: It's not meant to die tonight, and neither are you. Getting out alive is the whole victory — remember that, because it won't be the last time it finds us.

lines.speaker: Spook
lines.text: Small mercies. I'd rather not find out what 'not the last time' means up close again.
